status: Bounded resource checks accepted with explicit aggregate-RSS and short-case sampling dispositions

memory.disposition: One original candidate Papalexi cold/two-worker aggregate RSS spike was not reproduced in the three measured paired repeats. Original main/individual-worker peaks passed the specified budget; the additional conservative aggregate gate crossed once. Both builds had exactly two fork workers. Timestamped repeat peaks occurred in the fork phase about 1.33-1.37 seconds after the first analysis snapshot. No persistent regression or unexpected allocation was identified; the original crossing is retained, thresholds were unchanged, and production code was unchanged. Its precise cause is unresolved; R heap/COW/sampling variability is a possible explanation, not a demonstrated cause.
memory.interpretation: RSS snapshots are lower bounds; aggregate double-counts shared pages and is not physical/PSS memory.

allocations.scope: Separate serial Rprofmem/tracing diagnostics, absent from elapsed trials; cumulative R allocations exclude native C++/HDF5 malloc and fork memory.

limitations: Selected real Papalexi data plus declared synthetic stress cases; not full-transcriptome Replogle production performance.
Backed 512 MiB dense counterfactual exceeds a declared 256 MiB assay-materialization budget; not an enforced OS cap and not proof of out-of-RAM behavior on the 48 GiB Mac.
Short timing ratios remain diagnostic; compact fork peaks are not reliably sampled. Fit/bank counts and allocation diagnostics cover these paths.
Filesystem caches are not purged; cold/warm refers to model-fit caches. Backing files are freshly written before timed analysis.
One initial aggregate RSS outlier remains visible and non-reproduced; the repeat does not erase it.
Earlier build-mismatched batches are invalidated separately and excluded from all acceptance statistics.
